title: Before You Sleep, Let Your Shepherd Carry Today 🌙 | Night Prayer with Psalm 23
description:
Pray through the Shepherd's psalm, entrust your unfinished day to him, and rest with gentle KJV Scripture readings before sleep.

Subscribe and pray with us every morning and every night.

Chapters
0:00 Opening prayer
0:51 The Shepherd at the end of the day
3:19 Permission to lie down
4:56 Restoration and a faithful path
7:02 With me in the valley
9:01 A place at the table
10:51 Goodness and mercy beyond today
11:42 Declaration for tonight
12:13 One thing to carry into tomorrow
13:04 Scripture for sleep: gathered and kept
13:32 A gentle invitation
14:24 The Shepherd seeks his flock
15:39 Rest in the Shepherd's care
